Let's sketch the trajectory.

- We start at the given point and go along with the flow (upward and slightly to the left) until the trajectory intersects the $x$-nullcline, where the tangents are vertical.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14068646/assets/8c65f6381c6c2b9097779f4c560a0b039751f78653ef07e27cfc1575d85c0e07.png)

- Next, the flow continues going upward but then starts turning to the left.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14068646/assets/e5ed381ab1bc75741b2d1cd37a2c7ab1f19e37315874c9917bcf43d8df6cecb6.png)

- After that, the trajectory continues upward and slightly to the left, suggesting that it may converge to the origin
